name: Onyxia
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, Onyxia tends her brood and schemes to bring the mortal realms under black dragonflight rule. She is Deathwing’s daughter, while her brother Nefarian gathers armies in Blackrock Spire.

sections.title: The Broodmother in the Court
sections.body: Onyxia seeks power through guile while her brother Nefarian gathers armies in Blackrock Spire. Disguised as Lady Katrana Prestor, she has entered Stormwind’s highest noble circles. Trusted by the House of Nobles, she withholds soldiers and supplies from outposts in Westfall, Redridge, and the Burning Steppes. Her choices weaken the kingdom’s military and leave the mortal realms defenseless.

sections.title: Architect of Ruin
sections.body: Lady Katrana Prestor hides a predator’s cunning behind a painted smile. King Varian has gone missing on the way to a peace summit at Theramore. Prestor now holds deep influence over the young boy-king Anduin and has ensnared Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. The throne lies at the edge of her talons.

faq.answer: Lady Katrana Prestor is a noblewoman of Stormwind and a trusted adviser at court. With King Varian missing, she stands beside the boy-king Anduin and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep. Her counsel carries great weight with the House of Nobles.
Onyxia seeks to bring Stormwind under the black dragonflight’s sway, weaken its military power, and aid her brother Nefarian’s dominion over the region.
Onyxia lives in a subterranean lair in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh, where she tends the clutches of her black dragonflight.

faq.q: What is her connection to Nefarian and Deathwing?
faq.answer: Onyxia is Deathwing’s daughter and Nefarian’s younger sister. She works closely with him to restore the black dragonflight’s supremacy across Azeroth.
